title: Runtime-handoff resolution: the +0x16C bind stall is the pre-switch validity gate (FUN_00CC72A0/+0x7d), not case 9; FUN_007663D0 signature corrected; Q1/Q2/Q3 answered and unified to client-architecture 'Zone-in actor bind and Lua-class-readiness pipeline' part (a)
trigger: docs/runtime-frida-handoff.md (bahamut Frida runtime data: _onInit=0 hits, bind parked at state 9, +0x170=0xC0000024)

Q1_FUN_007663D0_signature.correction: client-architecture 'Zone-in actor bind and Lua-class-readiness pipeline' mislabeled +0x16C/+0x170 as control-record fields; they are CONTAINER fields. Confirmed by FUN_00773A30 ctor (param_1[0x5b]=+0x16C, param_1[0x5c]=+0x170) and FUN_00766F00 disasm (MOV ECX,EBX=container; PUSH record at both call sites 00766f53 and 00766fa0).
Q1_FUN_007663D0_signature.probeReads: the Frida probe sampled ECX -> its state(+0x16C)=9 and (+0x170)=0xC0000024 reads were CORRECT (container fields). Only the record id/name needed the stack arg.
Q1_FUN_007663D0_signature.case9NotTheStall: FUN_00CC9320 (BCS-Y-1801) is *this=sid, so *FUN_00CC9320(0xC0000024)==0xC0000024 tautologically; with container+0x170==0xC0000024, case 9 would pass. The stall is the per-frame PRE-SWITCH validation block.

Q2_create_SID_0xC0000024_and_populate_0x.verdict: REFRAMED. The control IS registered (special 0xc0000000-class table FUN_00CD81D0->FUN_00D0A3D0 returns a stored object) and +0x170 IS populated (=0xC0000024, never nulled). The gap is the resolved control FAILS the validity predicate FUN_00CC72A0 (its +0x7d byte == 0).
Q2_create_SID_0xC0000024_and_populate_0x.serverFixTarget: drive whatever marks the MyPlayer control valid/Lua-class-bound (+0x7d) -> unified to Q3 (spawn-burst completion).
Q2_create_SID_0xC0000024_and_populate_0x.plus0x7d_writer: NOT located here; a per-instance bind flag set deeper in the actor-create/bind path (multi-tier trace, cf. the +0x1bc writer). Best confirmed by a runtime write-watchpoint on (resolved_control + 0x7d).

Q3_FUN_006CDE30_dual_subdecoder.verdict: IF/ELSE, not parallel. One packet latches +0xe8 (sub-decoder this+0x40) XOR +0xe9 (sub-decoder this+0x94) via FUN_00445D20 buffer-equality; ring drain FUN_006CDA80 needs BOTH.
Q3_FUN_006CDE30_dual_subdecoder.onInit_proof: _onInit firer FUN_006F6D60 has EXACTLY 1 caller FUN_006C8CF0 (spawn-ADD); FUN_006C8CF0 has EXACTLY 1 caller FUN_006CBC90 (ADD leaf <- ring drain). So runtime _onInit=0 PROVES the ring never drained PROVES one latch never set PROVES the spawn-burst is incomplete.

unification: Q3 (ring never drains because one subdecoder latch never sets) is the upstream cause of Q2 (MyPlayer control never created+bound -> +0x7d==0 -> FUN_00CC72A0 fails -> FUN_007663D0 stalls at the pre-switch validate AND FUN_00766F00 skips +0x5C=1/LuaActorImpl install). Single server fix = complete the spawn-burst so both Group sub-decoders latch = client-architecture 'Zone-in actor bind and Lua-class-readiness pipeline' part (a).
blockerGateUnification: ONE predicate FUN_00CC72A0 (+0x7d via FUN_00CD7A30 BCS-Y-1581) gates BOTH the +0x16C bind-state advance 9->10 (client-architecture 'Zone-in actor bind and Lua-class-readiness pipeline') AND the actor+0x5C=1 Lua-bind (client-architecture 'Zone-in actor bind and Lua-class-readiness pipeline'). They are the same gate, not two.
